intro: Kestrel Logistics' office, wired from the scan. One cable pulled in the right place stops an attack spreading.

tasks.text: Contain patient zero: take that laptop off the network, but leave it switched on
tasks.hint: Find patient zero in the case first. Then pull its cable (click its wall socket) or shut its switch port. Don't switch it off: its memory is evidence.

tasks.text: Everyone else still reaches the file server and the internet
tasks.hint: Ping from fin-pc02 and ops-pc01. If they fail, you pulled the wrong cable.
